What to compare

Factor What to check Why it matters
Tip size Compare the contact point with the smallest target A broad tip hides cell boundaries
Device compatibility Confirm active protocol or capacitive support A stylus can fit physically and still not communicate
Palm behavior Test resting the hand near the grid Palm rejection depends on device and app
Button mapping Check whether side buttons work in the browser Driver features may not reach web controls
